XMRig_6.25.0_musl11_x64_xmrig.notes: Static musl ELF built with XMRig's own -DBUILD_STATIC=ON: stock configuration with the GPU backends and hwloc off, libuv 1.52.1 and OpenSSL 3.5.8 built from pinned sources as static archives. Build type Corpus carries CMake's Release optimisation and XMRig's -Ofast without XMRig's -s. -maes is XMRig's own; no -march is set. musl libc, libgcc, libgcc_eh, libstdc++ and libatomic code is removed by the musl glue baseline (removed_runtime_functions). libuv.a and OpenSSL libcrypto.a/libssl.a are linked statically (a static musl ELF cannot load a shared library), so their functions are in the image; they are removed by name with Recipe.exclude_functions, from the function names of those pinned archives (_musl_dep_symbols.py, generated by exercisers/musl_dep_symbols.py) and counted in excluded_function_count so kept + removed + excluded is the image total. Not removed, and so still in the image under the miner's name: unnamed functions (SMDA's .cold partitions and tail fragments), 32 OpenSSL helper names the miner also defines (fe_*, ge_*, load_3, ...), and the few libc/libstdc++ functions whose bytes differ from the baseline's copy (README, "The musl half"). The llhttp, Argon2/Blake2b, rapidjson and C++ standard library functions that other families also carry are removed by exact name as well (_stack_vendored.py), in the same excluded_function_count. Toolchains from musl.cc, pinned: x64 https://musl.cc/x86_64-linux-musl-native.tgz sha256 eb1db6f0f3c2bdbdbfb993d7ef7e2eeef82ac1259f6a6e1757c33a97dbcef3ad, x86 https://musl.cc/i686-linux-musl-cross.tgz sha256 93bd5504d5d0349258c43d7a668b506acbd627d31c0843a96e4b4c47b27a0180 (GCC 11.2.1 20211120, musl 1.2.2-git-50-gb76f37fd).

XMRig_6.25.0_musl11_x86_xmrig.notes: Static musl ELF built with XMRig's own -DBUILD_STATIC=ON: stock configuration with the GPU backends and hwloc off, libuv 1.52.1 and OpenSSL 3.5.8 built from pinned sources as static archives. Build type Corpus carries CMake's Release optimisation and XMRig's -Ofast without XMRig's -s. -maes is XMRig's own; no -march is set. musl libc, libgcc, libgcc_eh, libstdc++ and libatomic code is removed by the musl glue baseline (removed_runtime_functions). libuv.a and OpenSSL libcrypto.a/libssl.a are linked statically (a static musl ELF cannot load a shared library), so their functions are in the image; they are removed by name with Recipe.exclude_functions, from the function names of those pinned archives (_musl_dep_symbols.py, generated by exercisers/musl_dep_symbols.py) and counted in excluded_function_count so kept + removed + excluded is the image total. Not removed, and so still in the image under the miner's name: unnamed functions (SMDA's .cold partitions and tail fragments), 32 OpenSSL helper names the miner also defines (fe_*, ge_*, load_3, ...), and the few libc/libstdc++ functions whose bytes differ from the baseline's copy (README, "The musl half"). The llhttp, Argon2/Blake2b, rapidjson and C++ standard library functions that other families also carry are removed by exact name as well (_stack_vendored.py), in the same excluded_function_count. Toolchains from musl.cc, pinned: x64 https://musl.cc/x86_64-linux-musl-native.tgz sha256 eb1db6f0f3c2bdbdbfb993d7ef7e2eeef82ac1259f6a6e1757c33a97dbcef3ad, x86 https://musl.cc/i686-linux-musl-cross.tgz sha256 93bd5504d5d0349258c43d7a668b506acbd627d31c0843a96e4b4c47b27a0180 (GCC 11.2.1 20211120, musl 1.2.2-git-50-gb76f37fd).
